project_info.name: Tiangix Services / TiangixeCard
project_info.description: Digital marketplace platform connecting the US Latino community with verified, reliable service providers.
project_info.slogan: Servicios o negocios latinos verificados en todo USA.
project_info.archetype: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) blended with Archetype 4 (Swiss/Modern Clean)
project_info.vibe: Warm, trustworthy, distinctly Latino-friendly but professional and serious, modern marketplace.

primary.usage: Trust, core interactions, verification badges, main CTAs.

secondary.usage: Warmth, energy, secondary CTAs, highlighted text, Latino community vibe.

background.usage: Main app background, clean and airy.

success_verified.usage: Verified provider checkmarks, success toasts, verified badges.

fonts.heading: Poppins, sans-serif
fonts.body: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-900

rules: Never use Inter or default generic sans for headings. Apply Poppins strictly.
Headings must have tight letter spacing (tracking-tight).
Labels/Overlines must be uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-widest).

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing, Mobile-first. Clear visual hierarchy.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use p-6, p-8, p-12 for containers. Cards need minimum p-6 inner padding.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: Rounded components to feel friendly: rounded-2xl for large cards, rounded-xl for standard cards/widgets, rounded-full for buttons and badges.

grids.marketing_bento: Asymmetrical tetris grids for How It Works / Benefits sections.
grids.dashboard: Control Room layout with gap-4 or gap-6, 1px solid borders, no heavy shadows.

surfaces.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200/50, fixed top z-50. Always readable.
surfaces.cards: Solid white bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-300.
surfaces.dashboard_panel: Flat white background, crisp 1px borders, dense data presentation.

buttons.primary: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 h-12 md:h-14 font-medium transition-colors w-full md:w-auto text-lg
buttons.secondary: bg-orange-500 hover:bg-orange-600 text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 h-12 md:h-14 font-medium transition-colors w-full md:w-auto text-lg
buttons.outline: border-2 border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:border-blue-600 hover:text-blue-600 rounded-full px-8 py-3 bg-transparent transition-all

components.forms: Simple, large touch targets (h-12 min), rounded-xl inputs, clear labels.
components.badges: Clear visual indicator. Verified: bg-green-50 text-green-700 border border-green-200 rounded-full px-3 py-1 flex items-center gap-1 text-sm font-medium.

motion_and_interactions.hover: All interactive elements must change state. Buttons darken, cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and gain shadow.

rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

tech_stack_rules.components: Shadcn/UI heavily customized to match the brand identity. Use raw HTML/Tailwind for complex marketing page layouts.

hero_background.description: Abstract modern architectural background with warm orange and deep trust blue accents
hero_background.usage: Main landing page hero section background layer (use with bg-white/20 overlay)

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using standard React JS (.jsx/.js files). DO NOT create .tsx files.
Apply mobile-first design. Ensure all tap targets are at least 48px (h-12). Images should not exceed 80vh on mobile.

Use Shadcn UI components for complex interactions (Dialogs, Tabs, Forms, Select) but strip out the default 'Vercel-look'. Customize border radii (rounded-2xl) and colors to match the Tiangix guidelines.
Create a bilingual toggle (ES/EN) in the header. Ensure UI text is easily translatable.
Implement distinct dashboard views based on user role (Client vs Provider).
For the public eCard (provider profile), ensure it feels like a high-quality modern profile page (like Linktree + Airbnb listing), not an old directory listing.
Never use generic placeholder images. ONLY use the provided URLs in the media section.
Apply 'data-testid' to all interactive elements for robust testing.
